class.name: LandscapeWaterMaterial
class.brief_description: Built-in water material of rivers, streams and lakes ([LandscapeSpline3D]).
class.description: A transparent water shader made for the meshes of [LandscapeSpline3D]: - Ripples move with the flow of rivers and streams (flow mapping with two phases, without visible resets), at the speed of the points of the spline, slower near the banks. Lakes use the [member wind_velocity]. - The color depends on the depth of the water below the surface (absorption), the bottom is refracted. Reflections use the fresnel term and the specular reflections of the scene. - Foam appears along the shores and on the fast parts of rivers (rapids). The water fades out where it meets the terrain. - Optional gentle waves displace the vertices. Built-in tileable ripple and foam textures are generated when [member normal_texture] and [member foam_texture] aren't set. [b]Note:[/b] The material reads the screen and depth textures: transparent objects below the water aren't visible through it.

method.name: get_builtin_shader_code
method.description: Returns the code of the built-in water shader.

method.name: get_default_foam_texture
method.description: Returns the built-in tileable foam texture, used when [member foam_texture] isn't set.

method.name: get_default_normal_texture
method.description: Returns the built-in tileable ripple normal map, used when [member normal_texture] isn't set.
